feeds.description: The French Genealogy Blog is written by Anne Morddel, a Board Certified Genealogist and member of the Association of Professional Genealogists, who is a native Californian living in France. It is a 'how-to' blog, with each post explaining how to use the many resources available for families to research their French ancestors.

feeds.title: Vita Brevis
feeds.description: Vita Brevis is written by research staff at New England Historic Genealogical Society and other experts in the field. It covers our latest family history discoveries alongside news about the greater genealogical community.

feeds.title: Heart of the Family
feeds.description: Heart of the Family features family stories, technology, and methodology tips, and is home to the Genealogy Blog Party. Written by Elizabeth O'Neal. Our goal is to help you find creative, time-saving ways to make the past a part of your present.

feeds.title: TravelGenee
feeds.description: I am a part-time family history blogger, a part-time traveller. I blog about my family history finds, my trips, conferences, and work full-time in our family importing business to pay for all of this.

feeds.title: Genealogy & History News
feeds.description: Genealogy and history news and product announcements for Australians. We are a family business supplying the genealogy community for over 40 years. If you are researching your family history, and are looking for information check out our range of 9,000 products covering many countries.

feeds.title: Carolina Girl Genealogy
feeds.description: Cheri Hudson Passey has been researching her family and helping others get started with their research since the early 1980's. Born in Camden, South Carolina, her ancestors have been in the state for many generations. Her blog, Carolina Girl Genealogy has been instrumental in connecting with and sharing information about her family and the research process.

feeds.title: The Accidental Genealogist
feeds.description: A Blog for genealogists who like to write, and writers who happen to be genealogists!

feeds.title: Roots & Leaves | Family History and Genealogy
feeds.description: A Family History and Genealogy project covering the Greenlee, Murillo, Twyman, and Claros families.

feeds.title: Mole's Genealogy Blog
feeds.description: I started this blog to share with other family historians my experiences of over 40 years in genealogy, family history & local history. Though South African ancestry is of particular interest to me, there are no boundaries in family history. Blog by Rosemary Dixon-Smith.

feeds.title: Boston 1775
feeds.description: This blog is a miscellany of information about New England just before, during, and after the Revolutionary War, and about how that history has been studied, taught, preserved, politicized, mythologized, lost, recovered, discussed, described, distorted, and now digitized.

feeds.title: Donna's Irish Genealogy Resources | Donna M. Moughty
feeds.description: Donna Moughty is a professional genealogist focusing on genealogical methodology, technology and Irish genealogy and research.
